items.name: b-tinker
items.subject: the TINKER, the beetles' worker: a small, round, friendly dung beetle with a big glossy black head and big shiny eyes, royal-blue and brass shoulder plate, and its huge brass wrench resting over its shoulder so the wrench's open jaw rises beside its head; the top of a small backpack tank with a violet-glass gauge behind.

items.name: b-shieldbearer
items.subject: the SHIELDBEARER, the beetles' front-line tank: a rhinoceros beetle with one big black horn, big glossy black eyes, royal-blue and brass shoulder plates, and the top edge of its huge riveted royal-blue tower shield with a steel boss raised beside it.

items.name: b-bolter
items.subject: the BOLTER, the beetles' ranged soldier: a stocky beetle with big glossy black eyes and short mandibles, royal-blue and brass shoulder plates, a small canister helmet with a violet glass window, and the brass muzzles of its multi-barrel pressure repeater held across its chest, pointing toward the lower left, a wisp of steam at the muzzle.

items.name: b-breacher
items.subject: the BREACHER, the beetles' siege trooper: a heavy horned beetle with two curved black horns, big glossy eyes, royal-blue and brass shoulder plates, and the tip of its huge steel siege-drill arm thrusting diagonally across the frame toward the lower left.

items.name: b-arcwright
items.subject: the ARCWRIGHT, a beetle substance specialist: a slim beetle with long antennae, big glossy eyes, a royal-blue hooded mantle and brass collar, a violet glass canister on its back, holding its brass coil lance upright beside its head, a small violet arc crackling at the lance's coiled tip.

items.name: b-mender
items.subject: the MENDER, the beetles' field medic and mechanic: a round beetle with brass goggles over big glossy eyes, royal-blue and brass shoulder plates, a brass welding-torch arm curving over its head with a small bright white-orange flame, and the violet glass barrel of its pressure syringe-gun beside it.

items.name: b-warden
items.subject: the WARDEN, a beetle shield specialist: a beetle with big glossy eyes under a domed brass helmet with a violet glass window, royal-blue shoulder plates, and in front of it the brass frame of its barrier projector holding a curved translucent violet energy pane.

items.name: b-bombard
items.subject: the BOMBARD, the beetles' siege crawler: the wide, short mortar barrel of brass and dark steel aims up out of a royal-blue armoured beetle-shell hull with a violet glass band around the mortar's base, a small beetle crewman peeking from the hatch behind, steel legs at the bottom edge.

items.name: b-steamwing
items.subject: the STEAMWING, the beetles' flyer: a black beetle in a brass boiler wing rig seen head-on, two wide royal-blue membrane wings spread to both sides, a small chimney with white steam on its back, and a violet glowing beam emitter under its chin.

items.name: b-juggernaut
items.subject: the JUGGERNAUT, the beetles' ultimate walking fortress: a massive royal-blue armoured beetle-hull walker seen from the front, a big round violet furnace window glowing in the middle of its brow, two heavy brass cannons on either side, riveted steel and brass everywhere.

items.name: b-hornbreaker
items.subject: the HORNBREAKER, the beetle warlord hero: a Hercules beetle whose long curved black horn sweeps up and forward, big glossy eyes, a royal-blue cape and brass-trimmed royal-blue pauldrons, the head of his great steel-and-brass hammer with a violet glass core resting on his shoulder.

items.name: b-forgemaster
items.subject: the FORGEMASTER, the beetle engineer hero: a broad beetle wearing a tall brass smokestack helm with a thin wisp of smoke, brass goggles over big glossy eyes, a leather forge apron and royal-blue plates, a mechanical brass arm rig rising over his shoulder carrying a folded repeater turret, and the head of his forge hammer.

items.name: b-coilkeeper
items.subject: the COILKEEPER, the beetle substance savant hero: a slender beetle in a royal-blue robe with brass trim, big glossy eyes, a halo of copper coils arranged in a ring behind her head, and beside her the brass lantern of her staff where violet substance glows inside the glass.
